Subject: MAP checkpoint: ownership & turnaround for MSA/DPA edits

Hi Anna / team —

Great call today — appreciate the clarity on the legal priorities. As discussed, I’m attaching the current Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a clean MSA/DPA bundle so we can call out responsibility for edits and agreed turnarounds. Quick summary and proposed owners below.

Call highlights (short):
- GigaCorp legal flagged three high-priority redlines: indemnity, data residency, and liability cap.
- Security team needs the SOC 2 and network diagram before we can finalize the DPA clause on egress.
- Procurement will request standard PO terms; finance kickoff expected next week.

Proposed assignment (first pass):
- MSA substantive redlines (indemnity / liability cap): Karthik Iyer (Redwood legal) — 48h first pass.
- DPA language around residency & data flow: Karthik + Redwood Security (cc’d) to propose clause; 72h for alignment.
- Commercial terms (pricing, PO, billing cadence): Marissa Cole (AE) — coordinate procurement/finance.
- Signing logistics & final doc collate: Ben Carter (I’ll own DocuSign flow & final handoff).

Target close: we recommended week of May 3 (target signature by 2027-05-07) assuming 48–72h legal turnarounds and timely procurement PO.

Dependencies / blockers we called out:
- Redwood provides SOC 2 report & network diagram (we can share the redacted attestation link).
- GigaCorp confirms required data residency wording and any corporate-specific vendor addenda.
- Procurement sends initial PO terms (if they want to push longer payment terms that will impact commercial clearance).

Next steps (immediate):
1) Anna — please send your redline doc (if you already have it) and confirm which clause you want prioritized.
2) Karthik — can you commit to a 48h first-pass on the MSA redlines once we receive Anna’s doc?
3) Marissa — can you schedule the procurement kickoff with GigaCorp finance for 4/23 and drop MAP v1 into the Drive folder?

Attachments: 20270421_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), GigaCorp_MSA_DPA_clean_v1.zip (clean copies).

Thanks — I’ll follow up once we have the redline.

Best,
Ben Carter

Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: ownership & turnaround for MSA/DPA edits

Thanks Ben — appreciate the recap.

Attaching our annotated redline (GigaCorp_Redlines_MSA_v1.docx). High level: three items we need to resolve before procurement will proceed:
1) Indemnity — we need mutual indemnity with carveouts for gross negligence; prefer indemnity cap tied to annual fees rather than an absolute.
2) Data residency / transfers — need clarity on subprocessor notifications and a requirement for EU data to remain in EU (we’ll mark exact language).
3) Liability cap — would like to see an uplift for security incidents involving customer data; propose an exception for proven security breaches.

Timeline: if Karthik can turn a redline back in ~48 hours, that should be fine. Procurement is aiming for a PO the week of 4/26 but they may delay if legal items are unresolved.

Cc’ing procurement (procurement@gigacorp.com) — they’ll coordinate the PO terms and invoice recipients.

Anna Simmons
Senior Counsel, GigaCorp
legal@gigacorp.com
